Thanks to [https://www.bohemia.net Bohemia Interactive] and [https://www.armahosts.com Armahosts] there are plenty of official servers available for Spearhead 1944.

This page provides an overview on these - what they offer, how to find them, and how to make use of them.

== Official Servers ==

=== [ OFFICIAL ] - no mods and no custom game modes ===

==== Official Missions and Game Modes ====

Available missions are all official MP missions in the Spearhead 1944 CDLC:
* 1-24 COOP Campaign - [[Spearhead_1944_Scenarios#Operation_Cobra|Operation Cobra]]
* 1-4 COOP mission - [[Spearhead_1944_Scenarios#COOP_04_Der_Zahnarzt|Der Zahnarzt]]
* 1-6 COOP mission - [[Spearhead_1944_Scenarios#COOP_06_Attack_on_Mortain|Attack on Mortain]]
* 1-6 COOP mission - [[Spearhead_1944_Scenarios#COOP_06_Panzerkampfwagen|Panzerkampfwagen]]

==== Bohemia Interactive Server Table ====

The '''[ OFFICIAL ] Arma 3 Spearhead 1944''' servers provided by Bohemia Interactive are hosted in the US (East and West Coast), Europe (Germany) and Asia (Singapore).

==== Official Game Modes ====

{{Feature|important|All available for '''Lingevres''', '''Carentan''', '''Mortain''', '''Utah Beach''', '''Omaha Beach''' and '''Normandy'''}}

* EC 1-10 SPE Escape (SP/COOP)
* WL 1-16 SPE Warlords (PvP with AI or COOP against AI)

==== Armahosts Server Table ====

The '''[Official by Armahosts.com] Arma 3 Spearhead 1944''' servers provided by [https://spearhead-1944.com/#rent-a-server Open Group] are hosted in Europe (Germany and Finland).

== Server info ==

=== Custom Ingame Server Browser ===

Open the '''Multiplayer''' menu from the main menu. From there select in the center from the different options

==== Advanced Browser ====

# Select '''Official''' in the '''Server Type''' top bar
# Choose between '''All, PvP, PvE, PvPvE''' in the '''Game Type''' bar
# Select the desired server in the list and double click with the mouse or the '''Connect''' button in the bottom right

==== Simple Browser ====

# Select '''Official''' in the '''Server Type''' top left bar
# Choose between '''All, PvP, PvE, PvPvE''' in the '''Game Type''' top center bar
# Select the desired server in the list and double click with the mouse or the '''Connect''' button in the bottom right

Important: 
* The Simple Browser only shows servers without extra mods!
* You may not load any mods to be able to join servers shown here

==== Quickplay ====

# Choose between '''All, PvP, PvE, PvPvE''' in the '''Game Type''' top left bar
# Select the desired server in the list and double click with the mouse or the '''Connect''' button in the bottom right

{{Feature|important|* '''Quickplay lists also non official servers'''
* By default '''Quickplay''' only shows servers without extra mods - if you want play on the official servers with extra mods, activate the '''Any Extra Mods''' tickbox in the bottom center
* A Warning symbol is shown in the server list if the mod requirements dont match - either choose another server, or restart the game with the required mods, or use the External Server Browse to get/sync the mods as required by the given server}}

==== Direct Connect ====

# Open from the bottom center bar
# Get the IP and Port from the server list below for the desired server
# Enter IP and Port
# Hit the '''Search''' button in the center dialog
# Click '''Connect''' button in the bottom right

=== Standard Ingame Server Browser ===

# Open the '''Multiplayer''' menu from the main menu
# Click the '''Server Browser''' button in the bottom bar
# Click the '''Official Servers''' button in the top bar
# Wait for the server list to get populated
# Select the desired server with Spearhead 1944 in the name from the list and double click with the mouse or the '''Join''' button in the bottom right

{{Feature|informative|For easier finding and selection, click on '''Host''' at the top of the server list to sort the servers by name and thus group the Spearhead 1944 ones together.}}

For the official servers with mods:

# Open the '''Multiplayer''' menu from the main menu
# Click the '''Server Browser''' button in the bottom bar
# Click the '''Internet''' button in the top bar
# Click the '''Filter''' button in the bottom left
# Enter into the '''Host''' field: <syntaxhighlight lang="cpp" inline>armahosts</syntaxhighlight>
# Click the '''OK''' button in the bottom center
# Wait for the server list to get populated
# Select the desired server with Spearhead 1944 in the name from the list and double click with the mouse or the '''Join''' button in the bottom right

{{Feature|informative|Searching for server with a set ''filter'' can take up to a minute.}}

=== External Server Browser ===

# Open the '''official Arma 3 Launcher''' from Bohemia Interactive
# Load Spearhead 1944 via the '''DLC''' section
# Open the '''Servers''' section
# Click the '''Official''' tab in the top bar
# Wait for the server list to get populated
# Select the desired server with Spearhead 1944 in the name from the list and double click with the mouse or the '''Join''' button in the bottom right

{{Feature|informative|For easier finding and selection, click on '''Name''' at the top of the server list to sort the servers by name and thus group the Spearhead 1944 ones together.}}

For the official servers with mods:

# Open the '''official Arma 3 Launcher''' from Bohemia Interactive
# Load Spearhead 1944 via the '''DLC''' section
# Open the '''Servers''' section
# Click the '''Internet''' tab in the top bar
# Click the '''Filters''' button in the top right
# Enter into the '''Server Name''' field: <syntaxhighlight lang="cpp" inline>armahosts</syntaxhighlight>
# Click the '''Filters''' button again to close the dialog
# Wait for the server list to get populated
# Select the desired server with Spearhead 1944 in the name from the list and click '''Join''' button in the right side of the selected entry
# Click on "Setup DLCs and mods and join" bar in the bottom center

=== Direct Connect ===

Add the IP and port found in the server tables above.

== Customization ==

To be able to change '''difficulty level''' or '''mission''', or to customize the experience via [[Mission_Parameters|mission parameters]] (top right button in the mission lobby) or '''custom dialogs at the mission start''', you need to become '''server admin'''.

# [[Multiplayer_Server_Commands#HowTo|Open the chat window]]
# Type <syntaxhighlight lang="cpp" inline>#login ww2admin</syntaxhighlight> ([ OFFICIAL ]) / <syntaxhighlight lang="cpp" inline>#login admin</syntaxhighlight> ([Official by Armahosts.com])
# Adjust the [[Mission_Parameters|mission parameters]] when in the mission lobby (bottom in the top right) or adjust settings/locations at mission start in custom dialogs
or once admin
# Type <syntaxhighlight lang="cpp" inline>#missions</syntaxhighlight>
# Select difficulty (left side) and the mission (right side)

See [[Multiplayer Server Commands]] for more information and commands.
